title: QUIZ - 32
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Rewrite a power with a negative exponent as a fraction using the reciprocal rule
questions.question: Evaluate: \( 3^{-2} \)
questions.explanation: A negative exponent means take the reciprocal of the positive power: 3^{-2} = 1/3^{2} = 1/9 = \( \frac{1}{9} \).
questions.hint: A negative exponent means 'take the reciprocal', not 'make the value negative'.

questions.learningObjective: Apply the rule that any nonzero base raised to the power of zero equals one
questions.question: Evaluate: \( 10^0 \)
questions.explanation: Any nonzero number raised to the power of 0 equals 1, so \( 10^0 \) = 1.
questions.hint: Any nonzero base raised to the exponent 0 always equals 1.

questions.learningObjective: Apply the product rule to exponents that include negative values
questions.question: Simplify and evaluate: \( 4^{-4} \times 4^{1} \)
questions.explanation: Add the exponents: -4 + 1 = -3. So the expression equals \(4^{-3} = \frac{1}{64}\).
questions.hint: Add the exponents even when one or both are negative, then simplify the resulting power.

questions.learningObjective: Apply the rule that any nonzero base raised to the power of zero equals one

questions.hint: Any nonzero base raised to the exponent 0 always equals 1.
